mechanism: Replace artificial linear pelvis gap/tangent interpolation by a bilateral-foot-anchored knee/pitch curve with constant initial COM_x. Arms stay at measured standing angles. Furniture is pre-positioned under the reachable endpoint. This changes path equations, not rate, timing or contact limits.
endpoint_equations: Nine variables: six sagittal leg angles, root x,z,pitch. Nine residuals: bilateral foot x,z,pitch(6), pelvis min plane gap=.012(1), COM_x=initial COM_x(1), equal left/right knee displacement from q0(1). Original boxes and q0 initialization. One least_squares max80nfev; residual<=2e-6.
path_equations: For33nodes, interpolate left knee and root pitch from q0 to cold endpoint. Solve bilateral foot x,z,pitch(6), left knee(1), root pitch(1), COM_x=initial(1), max60nfev each, residual<=2e-6. Pelvis height and tangent are outputs, not imposed straight lines. Verify terminal gap/tangent agree<=2mm with chosen endpoint.
setup: Same saved wide standing patch supplies shape/height only. Translation along its tangent in[0,.25]m aligns a22mm-eroded target with endpoint. The predicted translated cloud is not a current observation.
witness: Exact static-bias endpoint direct command schedule<=10.4s, original .003rad step,.1 filter,.03 desired margin before any full-path solve. This actuator-only witness does not prove curved-path feasibility.
inputs: Measured standing frame0 and independently bound reset command; frozen robot/inertia/collider models. No rejected endpoint/vector/path input.
return_policy: One endpoint, one direct witness, one33node curve, one16node landing and independent audits. Stop on any failure; no retiming/retry. No global optimality claim. All intermediate solve records saved on failure.
independent_audits: Exact discrete command/filter/margin and original hold timing
Sampled mesh clearance with full furniture translation
further_admission: Require actual pre-positioned fixture with consistent collision/scoring and fresh camera/reset checks before any4090 motion. Model pass is not physical support or complete-cycle success.
